applies_why: This judge text decides the link underdetermined by requiring a text's own words to state the contrary, which is the verse-level stating-verse test the rule governs.
quote: but neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: 'When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together': either the defender's cited Luke 1:27, Luke 2:4 and Numbers 1:2 are a chain read together so K-C bars verse-by-verse contrary-in-own-words testing, or they are not such a chain; the judge text treats them as an answer but still relies on the retired test.
why: The judge text concludes underdetermined because no text's own words state the contrary, which is the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing the named defender chain by footing.
